```sql
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY event_id
           ORDER BY received_at DESC, row_id DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM app_clicks
)
SELECT *
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
```
